newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Wo Kee Hong falls on rights issue plan.
newsitem.headline: Wo Kee Hong falls on rights issue plan.

text.p: Shares of audiovisual equipment distributor Wo Kee Hong (Holdings) Ltd fell on dilution fears after the company announced a rights issue plan, brokers said on Friday.
"Fear of a dilution effect on share earnings following the rights issue triggered selling," said a sales manager at a local brokerage.
Wo Kee Hong shares fell HK$0.05 or 8.06 percent to HK$0.57 in late morning on volume of 14.22 million shares.

The company had said on Friday it proposed to raise HK$111.3 million before expenses by way of a rights issue of 222.59 million new shares in the proportion of one rights share for every five existing shares held at HK$0.50 each.
